factual_claims.claim: The Group’s headline return on equity was 13.1%, below the 17.4% reported a year earlier, while capital adequacy remained above the internal target at 20.8%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Return on equity 13.1% (10.7% in Q1 2026) and 17.4% in Q2 2025. Capital adequacy 20.8% (target 20.0%).

factual_claims.claim: The quarter also included strategic initiatives, notably the migration of LHV Pank’s core systems to Amazon Web Services, adoption of a product-based management model, and receipt of Estonia’s first MiCA crypto-assets service-provider licence.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The most important technological event... transition of the Bank’s core systems to the Amazon Web Services cloud... product-based management model... crypto-assets service provider license under the MiCA Regulation.

numerical_claims.claim: Consolidated net profit rose 25% quarter on quarter to EUR 24.7 million, including EUR 24.1 million attributable to the parent’s shareholders, while earnings per share increased to EUR 0.07 from EUR 0.06.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net profit EUR 24.7 m (EUR 19.7 m), of which EUR 24.1 m (EUR 19.8 m) is attributable to owners of the parent. Earnings per share EUR 0.07 (EUR 0.06).

numerical_claims.claim: Compared with Q2 2025, however, net profit declined 20% from EUR 30.8 million and earnings per share fell from EUR 0.09.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net profit EUR 24.7 m (EUR 30.8 m), Earnings per share EUR 0.07 (EUR 0.09).

numerical_claims.claim: For the first half of 2026, net profit was EUR 44.4 million, down 26% from EUR 59.9 million a year earlier.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net profit for the reporting period 24,687 (44,375 for 6M 2026) vs 30,765 (59,925 for 6M 2025).

numerical_claims.claim: Net operating income increased 7% from Q1 to EUR 79.0 million and was also 7% higher year on year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Total net operating income 79.03 (73.60 in Q1 2026) and 73.90 in Q2 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest income was the main contributor, rising 5% quarter on quarter to EUR 62.5 million and 8% from Q2 2025, supported by loan growth and a higher interest-rate environment.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net interest income 62.48 (59.28 in Q1 2026) and 57.64 in Q2 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: Net fee and commission income was broadly unchanged at EUR 14.6 million sequentially but declined 6% year on year, reflecting lower client activity.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net fee and commission income 14.64 (14.70 in Q1 2026) and 15.58 in Q2 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses fell 4% from Q1 to EUR 43.6 million, but were 8% higher year on year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Operating expenses 43.59 (45.57 in Q1 2026) and 40.51 in Q2 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: As a result, operating profit increased to EUR 35.4 million from EUR 28.1 million in Q1.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s Q2 operating profit was EUR 35.4 million (EUR 28.1 million in Q1 2026).

numerical_claims.claim: Loan and bond portfolio losses increased to EUR 5.8 million from EUR 1.3 million in Q1, compared with a EUR 4.2 million gain in Q2 2025.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Loan and bond provisions EUR 5.8 m (EUR 1.3 m) and EUR -4.2 m in Q2 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: The loan-loss reserve reached EUR 47.4 million at the end of June.
